consistency checks: entry is a file inside the inspected root AND is the launcher this package ships (bin/pa), argv[0] equals that entry, config is inside the install or the private app-support root
a bare caller-supplied {root} is recorded as provenance 'caller-string' and can never promote the evidence level
paths are resolved through existing ancestors, so macOS /var → /private/var cannot make a correct record look foreign

route only in a comment → capability absent
